name: semcache-lab
description: 语义缓存精度层的验证原型 — 六道闸逐一可开关，用来检验（或推翻）文章里的三条论断

scripts.start:zh: node scripts/with-env.mjs CORPUS_LANG=zh PAIR_MODEL=Xenova/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 RETR_MODEL=Xenova/multilingual-e5-small -- node --experimental-strip-types Server.ts
scripts.stub:redis: node scripts/with-env.mjs MODE=stub SEMCACHE_REDIS?=redis://localhost:6379/2 -- node --experimental-strip-types Server.ts
scripts.compare-stores:redis: node scripts/with-env.mjs MODE=stub SEMCACHE_REDIS?=redis://localhost:6379/2 -- node --experimental-strip-types scripts/compareStores.ts
scripts.store-conformance:redis: node scripts/with-env.mjs SEMCACHE_REDIS?=redis://localhost:6379/2 SEMCACHE_NS?=semcache_conformance -- node --experimental-strip-types scripts/storeConformance.ts
